cost.scope: Provider usage evidence only; unknown totals remain null and synthetic usage is not billed evidence

count_definitions.attempted_calls: Journaled attempt starts; do not prove HTTP dispatch
count_definitions.confirmed_http_deliveries: No separate transport-delivery census is reconstructed from attempt-start markers
count_definitions.continuations: Defined continuation phases, not necessarily dispatched HTTP calls
count_definitions.permitted_reprompts: Defined re-prompt phases, not necessarily dispatched HTTP calls
count_definitions.successful_calls: Responses accepted by the pinned parser; includes invalid model actions and is synthetic when labelled synthetic
